none: PAS CAM-614F17: Roman Coin : copper-alloy nummus of the House of Constantine, AD 307-361
contea di ritrovamento: City of Peterborough (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy nummus of the House of Constantine, AD 307-361 (Reece period 17). Reverse legend - no legend. Reverse shows Wolf and twins. Mint is uncertain, AD 330-337. Obverse legend reads [VRBS ROMA]. Obverse shows Helmeted bust left. Reverse fields and exergue is illegible. Die axis is 6 o'clock. Weight is 2.00g, diameter is 17.7mm, thickness is 1.5mm
